units.text: She walked to the window and looked out over the quiet harbour, where the last of the fishing boats were coming home.
It was the kind of afternoon that seemed to stretch on forever, warm and still, with the smell of cut grass drifting in from the fields beyond.

Long afterward, when the whole affair had passed into memory and the town had settled back into its ordinary rhythms, he would still find himself returning, again and again, to that single evening on the pier, and to everything that had been said and left unsaid between them under the failing light.
“You cannot mean that,” she said, turning sharply. “After everything we agreed?”
“Wait here,” he whispered. “I’ll be back before the clock strikes twelve.”
The train departed at 6:45 and covered 312 miles before the first stop, arriving in 1874 at a station built in 1859.
He counted 1, 2, 3, then 10, 20, 30, and finally reached 100 without once losing his place.
Reginald Ashworth met Dejah Thoris at the corner of Kensington and Marlborough, near the old Featherstonehaugh estate.
Neither Siobhan nor Bartholomew could pronounce Przybylski, though Xiuying managed it easily.
It was, as she liked to say, “the done thing” — and he’d never once thought to question it.
‘Curiouser and curiouser!’ she cried, and the whole room seemed to hold its breath.
Well; that is to say — no, wait: it was never quite that simple, was it? Not really.
